description: This file defines the 'HTMLPurifier_Doctype' class, which models a document type (DOCTYPE) in the context of HTML purification. It contains properties representing the doctype's name, associated modules, aliases, DTD identifiers, and whether it is derived from XML.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Doctype
classes.description: Represents a document type, containing information on modules used, aliases, DTD identifiers, and whether the doctype is XML-based.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for initializing an HTMLPurifier_Doctype instance with specified name, XML flag, modules, tidyModules, aliases, and DTD identifiers.
